notes: Fixed, manually annotated synthetic Russian corpus; not a sample of real stories.
Repeated searches measure timing/reproducibility; recall uses one result per unique question and k.
Search time includes trusted lineage and ranking; query embedding is reported separately. No text LLM or generation latency is measured.
Warm-cache, single-client exact filtered search; no large-corpus or concurrent-load claim.
Context-budget replay uses cached query vectors and the real narrative supplement service at top-k=8; private-character questions are excluded. Recent-beat deduplication is not simulated.
FAKE length-based embeddings: recall values are mechanical diagnostics, NOT semantic quality evidence.
